resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy (CO) for home sales
resale_co.issued_by: City of Salem Department of Inspections & Permits

fees.label: Certificate of Occupancy (2026 packet; one free with a paid rental registration each year)
fees.quote: Certificate of Occupancy $50 (one free CCO with paid Rental Reg. per year)

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill in the City of Salem Certificate of Occupancy & Landlord Rental Registration Application, mark "Sell property" as the purpose, and submit it with payment to the City of Salem Department of Inspections & Permits, 125 West Broadway, Salem. The Tax Collector signs off that taxes are paid, and the owner certifies there are no outstanding municipal charges. Applications are not processed without payment and complete documents.
resale_co.contact_title: Director of Housing and Economic Development (Housing Office); the CO form names only the Department of Inspections & Permits

resale_co.notes: The City's Construction Office page says CO inspections for existing structures, including home sales, are handled by the City's Department of Inspections & Permits (the State DCA runs the construction office itself). The City's CO application (April 2026) has a "Sell property" purpose box and lists a $50.00 initial inspection and $50.00 reinspection fee; the July 2026 version of the combined CO and rental registration packet also shows "Certificate of Occupancy $50". No inspection checklist, lead time or validity period is published; the form has an expiration date field for office use. No named inspector is published for the Department of Inspections & Permits (its Code Enforcement page says "Page under construction"), so the Housing Office director is given as the named contact; the site footer lists a Building Inspector line, 856-935-5510, and a Housing Department line, 856-935-0372 x 204. The email sbrown@cityofsalemnj.gov was decoded from the Housing Office page's email protection script. Rentals also need an annual Landlord Rental Registration ($100 per unit) and a lead-safe certificate.

authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on how many business days before closing you apply (more than 10, 4 to 10, under 4).

fees.quote: If you are applying for a certificate more than ten business days from the closing date the fee is $45 dollars

fees.label: State smoke/CO certificate, applied 4 to 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: if applying 4 to 10 business days from the closing date the fee is $90

fees.label: State smoke/CO certificate, closing less than 4 business days away
fees.quote: if the closing date is less than four business days the fee is $161.

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the NJ DCA Fire Safety portal (Certificate of Smoke Alarm, Carbon Monoxide Alarm, and Secondary Power Source Identification Label Compliance). Pay by e-check or credit card before submitting; a valid email address is required. The certificate is emailed once the application is submitted, the fee is paid and any required inspections are done. Homes heated by electricity with no CO alarm requirement should also email BFCE_CSDCMAC@dca.nj.gov.

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety is Salem City's fire code enforcing agency (LEA registry code S), is marked "SC" (the state issues smoke certificates) for Salem City on the DCA's July 17, 2026 state towns list, and is named for smoke detector compliance in the state fire directory (listed there as Salem City 1712). The DCA online smoke application's fire district feed lists Salem City as State jurisdiction and not smoke-certificate exempt, so it can be selected in the state's online application. The city has its own fire department (Salem City Fire Dept), but it is not the fire code enforcing agency. Apply to the DCA online; the DCA fees are the state's own published online fees.

other_items.label: Taxes and municipal charges paid
other_items.detail: The Tax Collector signs off on the CO application, and the owner certifies there are no outstanding municipal charges, including real estate taxes, water/sewer, court fees or other assessments.
